Abort compiling m2pim_NumberIO_BinToStr sincer15-7223-g92a5c5100c2519
+++ This bug was initially created as a clone ofBug #118689+++

As mentioned inPR118689, the modula 2 FER should build __builtin_c{t,z}{,l,ll} builtins, as the middle-end is using those e.g. in the niters analysis.
gcc/m2/gm2-gcc/m2builtins.cc says
/* Entries are added by examining gcc/builtins.def and copying those
   functions which can be applied to Modula-2.  */
and manually copies some builtins, but not these.
